name: activity_discover
description: List the approved installed activity templates with exact versions, controls, stages, alternatives, limits, lifecycle and review scope, the operations available to you, and unsupported capabilities with the alternative to offer. Decline unsupported requests with that alternative.

data.description: audience, operations, mode, independent, templates[], unsupported[], limits, workflow

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_describe_template
description: Fetch on demand the detail of one discovered template version: stages, transitions, groups, personalisable controls, scenarios and alternatives. Teacher, or tutor with full inspection, also receives equations, assumptions and constraints.

data.description: template, model, stages[], transitions[], groups[], controls[], scenarios[], alternatives[], model detail

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_prepare
description: Prepare the activity the host bound to this tool set from an approved template, optionally personalising permitted control parameters (canonical units), a scenario or a starting stage. The host supplies the activity, session and objectives. operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

parameters.description: Initial values of personalisable controls in canonical model units.

data.description: activityId, projection (learner view), expected guards, validation report

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_inspect
description: Read the activity. view "learner" (default) returns exactly the learner projection and the guards to copy into later calls. view "full" returns scientific state for teacher (policy.inspection.teacher) or tutor (policy.inspection.tutor = full) audiences only.

data.description: view, projection or state, expected guards

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

conditions: full view: policy.inspection.teacher (teacher) or policy.inspection.tutor = full (tutor)

name: activity_propose_revision
description: Check a bounded change without applying it: a parameter set (display units) within interactive controls, a listed scenario, or a declared stage transition. Approved templates are never edited. Exploratory composition (policy mode exploratory with compose.exploratory) creates a separate candidate labelled "exploratory, not reviewed". operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

document.description: Schema 2.0 visualization document (visualization_discover publishes its schema).

data.description: verdict, proposal, apply hint or exploratory candidate

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

conditions: exploratory composition: policy.mode exploratory and policy.exploratory.allowed

name: activity_request_reveal
description: Ask the host to authorize showing content groups, or a declared stage transition that reveals them. The host decides and persists the exposure before anything is shown. Returns authorized, pending or denied. operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

data.description: status (authorized | pending | denied), display, labels, projection, expected guards

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_operate
description: Apply a guarded operation as the tutor: commit parameters (display units), apply a scenario, reset, navigate or step, play or pause, set or reset a camera, or select. Parameter commits start a new run at index/time zero. operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

data.description: action, projection (learner view), expected guards, authorization

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_summarize
description: Deterministic interaction summary for the audience of this tool set through an explicit event cursor. It reports observations only and never infers understanding.

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_save
description: Ask the host to store a backup or a learner snapshot. Returns a reference only; the artifact stays in host storage. operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_restore
description: Reopen the bound activity from a host-stored artifact by its ID (never a path or URL). It restores paused, under the current host policy, with conservative exposure records. operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

data.description: restored, notes, projection (learner view), expected guards

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_close
description: Ask the host to close the activity. Pending previews are recorded and playback stops. operationId: unique per distinct request; repeat it only to retry the identical request.

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.

name: activity_sample
description: Isolated sampling of the exact installed model for teacher contexts (policy.sampling.allowed and policy.inspection.teacher). It never changes the learner run and its results are never cached or shown to the learner.

scope.description: validation (technical checks and their meaning), review (lifecycle and review scope, or null) and activity (learner-surface status, or null), reported separately.
